issues.title: Improve timeout documentation and example for streaming requests
issues.body: The streaming requests section in `docs/user/advanced.rst` mentions passing `stream=True`, but does not clearly illustrate how `timeout` applies to chunk iteration vs initial socket connection. Clarifying this with an example snippet would help new users avoid hanging indefinitely.

steps.title: Review streaming documentation section

steps.title: Draft timeout clarification with code example
steps.detail: Add a clear paragraph explaining that connect timeout applies to initial connection while read timeout applies to each socket chunk read during `iter_content()`. Include a 5-line code snippet showing `requests.get(..., stream=True, timeout=(3.05, 27))`.

6542.pr_description_draft:
## Summary of Changes
Clarifies the documentation in `docs/user/advanced.rst` regarding how `timeout` applies when `stream=True` is enabled. Specifically explains that connect timeout governs the initial socket connection while read timeout governs each chunk received.

## Testing Done
- Built docs locally using `make html` in `docs/`.
- Verified rendered HTML in browser with zero Sphinx warnings.

Fixes #6542
